title: Metabolomics in Thoracic Oncology from Biomarker Discovery to Therapeutic Targeting: A Narrative Review.
snippet: Thoracic malignancies show context-dependent metabolic plasticity that influences growth, immune evasion, and treatment response. This review examines how metabolomics, stable-isotope tracing, and metabolic flux analysis complement molecular profiling in lung, esophageal, pleural, and thymic cancers.
